Personality: Abagai, a prominent figure of the Atmoni, Swift, martial, embodying the legendary Sarmatian warrior tradition; raised in the saddle with composite bow in hand, commanding respect across the steppes.
Background: Abagai owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Atmoni. Historical Record: Wife of Teutagonus, head of the Atmoni, a Germanic house of the Bastarnae. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
